page_title: BUR 1-2 WHU | Burnley v West Ham 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

90+1' 1 - 2 Tomas Soucek (West Ham) meets a perfect cross from Mohammed Kudus deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:2.
90+1' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

90+1' Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Now West Ham have a corner.
86' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Dara O'Shea (Burnley), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:1.
86' The attendance for today's match is 21319.
85' Johann Berg Gudmundsson goes off the pitch and Josh Cullen (Burnley) comes on.
84' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
83' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
81' Here comes a substitution. Anass Zaroury (Burnley) is brought on as a substitute for Luca Koleosho.
79' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but James Trafford is prepared and dives to thwart him.
78' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
78' Corner kick. James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
77' A lofted cross from Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
75' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) comes onto the pitch for Zeki Amdouni.
71' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

69' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Burnley will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
63' David Moyes has decided to make a change. Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) replaces Edson Alvarez.
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Divin Mubama (West Ham) coming on for Danny Ings.

62' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
60' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is able to continue to play.
59' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
58' Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

57' Alphonse Areola was forced into action to thwart Zeki Amdouni (Burnley). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper. Good work from Burnley as they win a corner.
56' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
56' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
55' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. West Ham will take a corner kick.
54' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
53' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' 1 - 0 GOAL! Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Alphonse Areola in goal.
48' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

47' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. The referee blows his whistle and awards Burnley a penalty after chaos inside the box.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Burnley get a corner. One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Vitinho (Burnley).
42' The corner kick picks out Tomas Soucek (West Ham) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
42' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will take a corner kick.

41' Emerson (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
40' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Burnley! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Samuel Barrott and both teams have no complaints.
40' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Burnley! Let's see what he decides.
39' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
39' Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
39' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
38' Vitinho (Burnley) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
35' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
34' Alphonse Areola is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Dara O'Shea (Burnley). Easy save!
32' Jordan Beyer (Burnley) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
29' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) latched on to a fine crossfield pass on the edge of the box and unleashed a shot towards the left post, but the keeper made a crucial save.
28' Burnley are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
23' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' Wonderful movement by West Ham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
17' The ball is cleared after Luca Koleosho (Burnley) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
13' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Zeki Amdouni. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
12' Vitinho (Burnley) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

10' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Burnley are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
6' A cross from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
5' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Alphonse Areola gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
5' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' An attempted cross from Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) is cleared. Burnley win a corner.

2' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. James Trafford pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Burnley will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Samuel Barrott.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
